qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: Two titles changed: 汁 and 毎度. All 121 inherited direct entries remain in EN order; ten RU-only entries follow them (131 total). Four candidate-stage RU additions were removed (水平線–地平線, 歯車–車輪, 欧米–欧州, 欧米–ヨーロッパ). Three exact segment overlaps are guarded; the fourth, 毎度–すまない «спасибо», is a comma-split artifact of a connected label. This is not proof of exhaustive runtime quiz safety.
